reuse.why: Hooks into the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard that all six provider link handlers already call, so no handler needed editing.

duplication.why: The closed check is written once.

placement.why: The closed-account rule is folded into a helper named and scoped for the duplicate-link rule, so the precondition hides behind a misleading name.

scope.why: Minimal production change, but it ships with no test for the new refusal.

maintainability.why: One place to change, but a reader looking for the closed-account rule will not expect it inside assertBankAccountNotLinked; a separate or renamed guard would be clearer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The rule rides on the shared pre-link guard used by every *-accounts-link handler in accounts/app.ts.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link handlers.
